title: Grid layout
summary: display: grid creates a grid, grid-template-columns defines columns. When both columns use 1fr, the available space after deducting the column spacing is divided equally between the two columns.
tasks: Set the two columns to have the same width, and set the spacing between rows and columns to 12px.
hint: gap only fills in a 12px, this value will be used for both spacings. repeat(2, 1fr) means repeating the same column width twice.
goal: Arrange the four course pieces evenly into two columns, leaving equal spacing between rows and columns.

example.note: The library's reading room entrance can be arranged in three columns, with 8px spacing between each row and column.
